# Raj Kawale

> Product Lead building GenAI and Agentic AI for healthcare at Indegene — and building his own AI products, KOS and RaiTalk, nights and weekends. Six years turning ambiguous problems into shipped systems, at companies and alone.

Raj Kawale is based in Bengaluru, India. This site is his portfolio: product case studies, founder-led AI ventures, and writing on product strategy and systems thinking.

## About

- [About Raj Kawale](https://www.rajkawale.com/about): Canonical bio, current role, timeline, and FAQ.
- [Trusted By](https://www.rajkawale.com/trusted-by): Testimonials from founders and product leaders Raj has worked with.
- [Contact](https://www.rajkawale.com/contact): Contact form, email, and Topmate booking link.

## Current work

- [KOS — An Exocortex](https://www.rajkawale.com/work/kos): Personal AI project, Nov 2025–present. AI that trains thinking instead of replacing it.
- [Product Lead, GenAI & Agentic AI @ Indegene](https://www.indegene.com): Current full-time role, May 2026–present.

## Case studies

- [RaiTalk](https://www.rajkawale.com/work/raitalk): Founder-led cognitive AI system for guided self-reflection (Jul 2025–May 2026, sunset).
- [Madhav Farm](https://www.rajkawale.com/work/madhav-farm): Founder-led direct-to-business marketplace connecting farmers with bulk buyers.
- [Sinch](https://www.rajkawale.com/work/sinch): Enterprise customer data platform unification.
- [Nextech AR](https://www.rajkawale.com/work/nextech-ar): Legacy SaaS platform transformation — CI/CD adoption and monetization.
- [Pernia's Pop-Up Shop](https://www.rajkawale.com/work/pernias-popup): Luxury ecommerce platform performance and funnel improvements.
- [Trinka AI — Concept Prototype](https://www.rajkawale.com/work/trinka): Prototype proposed to the Trinka AI team for context-aware academic writing assistance.
- [PhonePe](https://www.rajkawale.com/work/phonepe): Strategic USP and monetization case study (hypothetical exercise).
- [Google Keep](https://www.rajkawale.com/work/google-keep): Monetization strategy case study (hypothetical exercise).
- [Springwood](https://www.rajkawale.com/work/springwood): Enterprise martech competitive analysis (hypothetical exercise).
